benefits_features.Upto 20x Reward Points: For every Rs.100 spent on birthday, earn 20 reward points.

benefits_features.Accept Globally: You can use your SBI PRIME Credit Card in 24 million outlets all over the world which includes 1.25 lakh outlets in India.
benefits_features.Card Replacement facility: Replace your lost or stolen SBI PRIME Credit Card from any location across the world.
benefits_features.Add-on Cards: Extend the benefits of your SBI PRIME Credit Card to up to two members of your family (spouse, parents, children or siblings who are at least 18 years old)

how_tos.How to Apply for SBI PRIME Credit Card O:
The process that must be followed to apply for the credit card online is mentioned below:
- Visit https://www.sbicard.com/en/apply-credit-card/sbicard-rewards-prime.page
- Click on 'Apply Now'.
- Under SBI PRIME Card, click on 'Apply Now'.
- On the next page, click on 'Start Apply Now'.
- Enter personal details such as your name and mobile number. Agree to the terms and conditions and click on 'Continue'.
- Next, KYC/other details must be provided.
- If you see the "eligible for your credit card" will be displayed online, which means you have been approved online. 
The bank will reach out to you within the next two working days and will inform you about the required documents and an appointment to collect the same from you. Once the documents are submitted, the bank will take 2 to 3 days to process the application.

miscellaneous:
SBI PRIME Credit Card Limit:
The credit limit of the credit card is at the discretion of the bank. The bank has to decide the credit limit for a particular credit card; the bank considers several factors such as the credit history of the applicant, credit score along with the repayment behavior of past and current debts.

faqs.1. Is the SBI PRIME Credit Card contactl: Yes, the SBI PRIME Credit Card is powered with contactless technology that makes swipes less transactions at POS terminals.
faqs.2. Can I use SBI PRIME Card Amount?: Yes, you can use SBI PRIME card anywhere in the globe. Every time you use the card, accept or reject a transaction across the world. A foreign transaction fee of Rs.950 or 3.5% of transaction amount will be charged.
faqs.3. How can I report the loss of my SBI P: If you have lost your SBI PRIME Credit Card in India, you can report it immediately to the bank by calling its 24x7 helplines at 1800 120 120 or 022 6260 7500. If you have lost your card abroad, you can call the free toll number or the respective number specific to the country to report your loss. The list of toll-free numbers from more than 150 countries is available on the SBI website or via the Visa website.
faqs.4. How many add-on cards can I avail on: You can apply for up to two add-on cards on your SBI PRIME Credit Card.
faqs.5. Is balance transfer facility availabl: Yes, SBI PRIME Credit Card comes with a balance transfer facility that enables you to allow the transfer of the outstanding balance on your other bank credit cards to your SBI PRIME Credit Card. Once the amount is transferred, you can pay it back in easy monthly installments at a lower interest rate in flexible tenure.
faqs.6. How can I contact SBI through post if: In case of any query related to SBI PRIME credit card, you may contact SBI Card by sending a mail to this address: SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited, Unit 601-602 & 605, Aggarmal Millenium Tower, E Wing, 12-12A, Netaji Subhash Place, New Delhi-110034
faqs.7. How can I track the status of my appl: You can check the status of your SBI Prime credit card application by visiting the link https://www.sbicard.com/apply/faqs/retrieve-online-form where you click the box under "Track Application", enter your reference number or application number and click on "Track".
faqs.8. I couldn't complete my application pr: In case you were unable to complete your application process, click on the link https://www.sbicard.com/apply/faqs/retrieve-online-form and under "Retrieve Application" enter your email id and request for your respective application and click on "Retrieve".
faqs.9. My application for SBI Prime credit c: Some of the reasons why your application for the SBI PRIME card can be rejected could be that you may not meet the required eligibility criteria. In case your credit score is low, or if you do not meet the minimum monthly income criteria, then the bank can reject your application. In case you are unable to submit the correct documents, then there is a high probability to reject your application.
faqs.10. What are the eligibility criteria to: Salaried individuals must be at least 21 years with 2 years employed; individuals must be 25 years and above to be eligible to apply for SBI Prime Card. Retired pensioners aged between 40 years and 70 years can also apply for this credit card.
